name: Ground
overview: Scripture reveals that the ground is the fundamental source from which God formed man, animals, and vegetation, highlighting His sovereign creative power (Genesis 2:7, 19; 2:9). After the fall, the ground became cursed as a consequence of human sin, bringing toil and sorrow in obtaining sustenance (Genesis 3:17). Ultimately, man’s origin and destiny are tied to the ground, emphasizing human dependence on God’s design and the reality of mortality (Genesis 3:19, 23).
